# Rendered by giantswarm-platform-manager, agent-platform definition. Do not edit by hand:
# the next reconcile writes it again from the installation's inputs.
global:
  domain: ember.agentlab.test
components:
  kagent:
    enabled: true
    valuesFromRefs:
      - kind: Secret
        name: kagent-credentials-revision
        valuesKey: revision
        targetPath: oauth2-proxy.podAnnotations.kagent-credentials-revision
  agent-manager:
    enabled: true
    valuesFromRefs:
      - kind: Secret
        name: muster-credentials-revision
        valuesKey: revision
        targetPath: podAnnotations.muster-credentials-revision
  muster:
    valuesFromRefs:
      - kind: Secret
        name: muster-credentials-revision
        valuesKey: revision
        targetPath: muster.oauth.server.existingSecretChecksum
      - kind: Secret
        name: muster-credentials-revision
        valuesKey: revision
        targetPath: muster.oauth.server.storage.valkey.existingSecretChecksum
  valkey:
    valuesFromRefs:
      - kind: Secret
        name: muster-credentials-revision
        valuesKey: revision
        targetPath: valkey.auth.usersExistingSecretChecksum
  model-manager:
    valuesFromRefs:
      - kind: Secret
        name: muster-credentials-revision
        valuesKey: revision
        targetPath: podAnnotations.muster-credentials-revision
postgres:
  enabled: true
llmRouting:
  enabled: true
kagent:
  providers:
    anthropic:
      apiKeySecretRef: kagent-anthropic-key
      config:
        baseUrl: http://agentgateway.agent-platform.svc:8081
        maxTokens: 32000
  oauth2-proxy:
    config:
      existingSecret: kagent-oauth2-proxy-credentials
    extraArgs:
      oidc-extra-audience: dex-k8s-authenticator,kagent,backstage # gitleaks:allow
muster:
  muster:
    oauth:
      server:
        existingSecret: muster-oauth-credentials
        storage:
          valkey:
            existingSecret: muster-valkey-credentials
        trustedAudiences:
          - dex-k8s-authenticator
          - kagent
          - backstage
gateway:
  jwksEgress:
    enabled: true
extraObjects:
  - apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1beta1
    kind: ReferenceGrant
    metadata:
      name: agentgateway-jwks-dex
      namespace: giantswarm
    spec:
      from:
        - group: agentgateway.dev
          kind: AgentgatewayPolicy
          namespace: agent-platform
      to:
        - group: ""
          kind: Service
          name: dex
agent-platform-mcps:
  agentgateway:
    jwt:
      extraProviders:
        - issuer: https://dex.ember.agentlab.test
          audiences:
            - backstage
          jwks:
            remote:
              backendRef:
                name: dex
                namespace: giantswarm
                port: 5556
              jwksPath: /keys
              cacheDuration: 5m
valkey:
  valkey:
    auth:
      usersExistingSecret: muster-valkey-credentials
      aclUsers:
        default:
          passwordKey: valkey-password
workspaces:
  enabled: true
workspace-manager:
  providers:
    instances:
      - name: github
        kind: github

          - dex-k8s-authenticator

customerActions.action: Create Secret kagent-anthropic-key in namespace kagent with key ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, or add a ModelConfig in the portal; until then default-model-config (ModelConfig.api.kagent.dev) stays ResolvedRefs=False.
customerActions.why: the model key is the installation's own: the definition references the Secret and renders no value for it, and no value is supplied at commit; until the Secret exists the verify reads the runtime feature as waiting for the customer

probes.key: oauth2-proxy --oidc-extra-audience argument
muster ConfigMap trustedAudiences
muster ConfigMap dex connectorId, where the definition renders one
/api/agents answered 403 by oauth2-proxy
/oauth2/start 302 to Dex with client_id=kagent
Dex knows every rendered client and its redirect URI: the connector its /auth answer names answers 302 or its login form
Dex started after every referenced client Secret last changed its data, for every client of the dex patch with a secret reference
no audience mismatch in oauth2-proxy's log
Secret kagent-oauth2-proxy-credentials and ServiceAccount kagent-flux
ModelConfigs in the kagent namespace
kagent HelmRelease .spec.values.providers
Konfiguration agent-platform-konfiguration on its GitRepository's revision: behind within its reconciliation interval reads rolling, longer drifted
HelmReleases agent-platform, kagent, connectivity, muster, mcps Ready
the Deployments that read muster's credentials Available: muster, its Valkey, and klaus-gateway, agent-manager, cluster-manager and model-manager where each runs
kagent pods Running and the CNPG cluster healthy
certificates.k8s.io/v1beta1 podcertificaterequests served by the apiserver (Agent Substrate's feature gates, the 4 line)
live values equal the rendered manifests
MCPServer objects of the installation itself
MCPServer objects registered under extras/agent-platform/mcpservers, present and none Failed
muster's OAuth protected-resource metadata

dimensions.key: components.muster.valuesFromRefs / components.valkey.valuesFromRefs / components.klaus-gateway.valuesFromRefs / components.agent-manager.valuesFromRefs / components.cluster-manager.valuesFromRefs / components.model-manager.valuesFromRefs (the credentials revision the HelmReleases of the workloads that read muster's credentials take into their charts' checksum values or a pod annotation)

agent-platform/secrets/muster-credentials-revision.yaml / agent-platform/secrets/muster-oauth-credentials.yaml stringData.credentials-revision / agent-platform/secrets/muster-valkey-credentials.yaml stringData.revision (the revision held by muster's credentials Secrets and by the Secret the HelmReleases read, so a rotation restarts every workload that reads them)
components.kagent.valuesFromRefs (kagent's credentials revision the kagent HelmRelease takes onto the oauth2-proxy's pod annotations)

agent-platform/secrets/kagent-credentials-revision.yaml / agent-platform/secrets/kagent-oauth2-proxy-credentials.yaml stringData.credentials-revision (the revision held by the oauth2-proxy's credentials Secret and by the Secret the kagent HelmRelease reads, so a rotation of the kagent client or cookie secret restarts the proxy)
agent-platform/secrets/ (every other Secret: name, namespace, labels, keys)
the patch's top-level keys (every key no other dimension names)
agent-platform/kustomization.yaml (resources and the chart line's patch)

mcp-<name>/credentials-revision.enc.yaml / mcp-<name>/kustomization.yaml patches / mcp-<name>/oauth-credentials.enc.yaml stringData.CREDENTIALS_REVISION / stringData.credentials-revision / mcp-<name>/valkey-credentials.enc.yaml stringData.revision (the credentials revision the server's and its Valkey's HelmReleases read into their charts' checksum values, so a rotation restarts both; the private-address values patch sits in the same list)
mcp-<name>/ (each server's kustomization, Dex client and credential Secrets)
agent-platform/ (the Component's kustomization, and its ConfigMaps' apiVersion, kind and metadata)
agent-platform/app-config.yaml app.portals (the Agent Platform shell, where backstage 3.x routes the platform's pages)
agent-platform/values.yaml backstage.extraAppConfig (the Component's app-config file and its checksum)

commit: mode "commit" with installation (one installation) opens the pull requests above as you, in this order, and records the Action on the hub in pending approval (ready to merge when every target is a test installation: no Team review); reconcile_capability with installations (a set) is one wave: one action, one approval, the pull requests per installation, merged one installation after the other in the order above, each verified before the next; secrets carries the values of suppliedSecrets by field, and no value leaves the encrypted files
